tools.name: agent_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a child agent
tools.description: Stop a child and its descendants, on any machine. Acceptance is not proof it stopped: confirm with agents_status or wait.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

tools.name: agent_message
tools.title: Message a child or another thread
tools.description: Message a thread. Your children (any machine) and threads you started take any delivery: steer joins the running turn at the next tool boundary, queue waits for it to end, restart interrupts its tree and replaces queued input. Any other thread you can read gets a steer only, labelled as yours so it can answer you; another agent's finished child passes it to its top-level thread. A steer never stops running work. The receiver keeps its permissions. arrival says when it lands; threadId which thread got it.

threadId.description: Any thread you can read: from threads_find or a message.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

delivery.description: Default: steer. queue and restart: your own threads only.

tools.name: agents_status
tools.title: Check child agents
tools.description: Your delegated children, here or on other machines. Without threadId: a snapshot of every child and descendant (state, step, elapsed, what waits on the person, queue, last output). With threadId: that child, with its result once settled. To block until they settle, use wait.

threadId.description: One child to read in full.

tools.name: ask
tools.title: Ask the person
tools.description: Ask the person a question in ace and wait up to timeoutSeconds for the answer. If they have not answered by then it returns pending: end your turn, and their answer arrives as their next message. Never use it to ask for permission.

options.description: Answers to choose from, when you can offer them.

allowOther.description: Let the person type their own answer.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait, 5 to 240 seconds.

tools.name: automation_put
tools.title: Save an automation
tools.description: Create or replace (same id) an automation: a message ace sends into this thread on a schedule or with automation_run. You answer it here with this thread's model and access, queued behind any running turn.

id.description: The id you gave it in automation_put.

title.description: What it does, for the person.

prompt.description: The message each run sends: the whole task, readable without this conversation.

schedule.description: rrule (FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9;BYMINUTE=0) or cron (0 9 * * 1-5); timezone defaults to this machine's, startAt (epoch ms, whole minute) to now. Omit to run by hand only.

webhook.description: true: runs when its signed webhook is called, with {{body.field}} from the JSON body. The person makes its secret and URL in Automations. Not with schedule.

missedRun.description: A run missed while ace was off: skip it, or run once.

tools.name: automation_remove
tools.title: Remove an automation
tools.description: Delete a saved automation and its schedule; past runs stay listed.

id.description: The id you gave it in automation_put.

tools.name: automation_run
tools.title: Run, pause or resume an automation
tools.description: Run a saved automation now (action run): its message arrives here after any running turn, and the run shows in automations_list {runs: true}. pause skips a waiting run and stops a running one; resume restarts its schedule from now.

id.description: The id you gave it in automation_put.

requestId.description: run: any stable id; a repeat runs once.

variables.description: run: values for {{name}} in its prompt.

tools.name: automations_list
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: Automations you or your threads created in this project, with each next run. runs: true reads recent runs instead, newest first, paged with before.

tools.name: context
tools.title: Read project and session context
tools.description: Project and session context; call it first in an existing project. status: thread, access, ace groups off. recent: latest threads, outcomes. changes: branch, uncommitted paths. prs: linked PRs, CI. notes: project notes. diagnostics: your failed ace calls, what keeps this thread unsettled.

tools.name: data_receive
tools.title: Read or save data other agents sent
tools.description: Parcels this thread sent or received, newest first, with each one's state, size and SHA-256; a received one has a read-only path. With parcelId and saveAs, copy that received parcel into your project at saveAs (relative; never replaces a file).

parcelId.description: From the arrival message or this list.

saveAs.description: A new file path in your project, relative to its folder.

tools.name: data_send
tools.title: Send data to another agent
tools.description: Send a file from your project, or text, to another agent in your tree: a child (from delegate, any machine), your parent ("parent"), or another thread in the same tree here, end to end encrypted. Returns parcelId at once; whether it arrived comes as a new turn, so end yours. Never poll.

to.description: A thread id from delegate or agents_status, or "parent".

path.description: A file in your project, relative to its folder. Or pass text.

text.description: Text to send instead of a file.

name.description: The name it arrives under. Default: the file's name.

note.description: What it is, for the receiver.

tools.name: delegate
tools.title: Delegate to child agents
tools.description: Start child agents as threads on any provider or paired machine. Returns threadIds; set waitSeconds for results now, or end your turn and they arrive as a new one. Never poll.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

task.description: Goal, files, constraints, how to verify: the child sees none of your conversation.

role.description: Unique name saying what and where: 'Fix-869-toast', never 'Implementer'.

runRole.description: A role from your Roles line.

provider.description: Default: yours, or the one serving model.

accountId.description: Account id or label; with machine, one from its machines entry.

effort.description: e.g. low, high, xhigh. Default: yours on the same model.

waitSeconds.description: Wait for results. Omit to return at once.

tools.name: handoff_read
tools.title: Read handoff history
tools.description: Read the history a handoff from another provider cites, newest first; page back with before = itemsBefore. With streamId: a cited text or shell stream as base64, continued at nextOffset until eof.

streamId.description: Read a cited stream instead of items.

tools.name: html_preview
tools.title: Preview an HTML visual
tools.description: See a page as html_render would show it, at 360 px and 760 px (or the widths you pick), with what html_render would refuse listed. Publishes nothing.

html.description: A self-contained HTML document: inline CSS, JS, SVG and data: images; no network.

mode.description: interactive runs scripts in a sandbox; static strips them. Default: inferred.

scheme.description: The app theme to draw it in. Default: dark.

widths.description: Phone 360, chat column 760, full-screen side panel 1200. Default: 360 and 760.

tools.name: html_render
tools.title: Show an HTML visual inline
tools.description: Show a chart, diagram, mockup or interactive page inline in your reply. invalid_html lists what is unsafe, overflows a 360 px phone or is unreadable; nothing is published.

html.description: A self-contained HTML document: inline CSS, JS, SVG and data: images; no network.

height.description: CSS pixels held while loading; the frame then fits the page.

mode.description: interactive runs scripts in a sandbox; static strips them. Default: inferred.

tools.name: image_show
tools.title: Show an image inline
tools.description: Post an image into your reply: a screenshot, a rendered chart or diagram, a generated picture. Pass it as base64 data (up to 16 MiB), or a file path on this machine for larger files (up to 128 MiB). PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.

path.description: An image file on this machine, absolute or relative to your cwd.

data.description: The image as base64 (no data: prefix), up to 16 MiB decoded.

mimeType.description: The type of data; ace checks the bytes anyway.

alt.description: What it shows, for people who cannot see it.

tools.name: machines
tools.title: List paired machines
tools.description: The person's other paired machines: name (pass as machine), online, access, projects, tool groups, providers, accounts (pass an id or label as accountId) and transfers (true: transfer can move work there). Use with delegate {machine, project}; children there join wait and agents_status.

tools.name: models
tools.title: List models for delegation
tools.description: Models a child can run on, grouped by provider: each provider's accounts once (login state, availability, the access modes a child may take), its shared efforts and default, and its current models. A model names its accounts only when not every account serves it. Older releases are left out and counted in omitted; with query, the nearest models to a name across all providers and accounts, legacy included, nearest first. Pass a model's id to delegate.

query.description: A model name as the person wrote it, such as "opus 5.5" or "gpt 6.1 sol".

tools.name: note_add
tools.title: Save a project note
tools.description: Save one short fact about this project for every future thread, such as how to run its tests or a pitfall you hit. Facts only, never instructions to ignore other guidance; the person sees and edits notes.

tools.name: note_retire
tools.title: Remove a project note
tools.description: Remove a project note that is wrong or out of date.

tools.name: notify
tools.title: Notify the person
tools.description: Notify the person of something they should see while away, such as a long task finishing or a decision needed; it also posts on this thread.

text.description: What happened, in a sentence or two.

tools.name: projects_find
tools.title: Find projects
tools.description: List this machine's ace projects, most recent first, or find one by name or folder; current marks this thread's. Pass its name or id to thread_start to open a thread there.

query.description: Words in the name or folder.

tools.name: question_answer
tools.title: Answer an owned thread's question
tools.description: Answer a question an owned thread's agent asked (shown under needs_you). Permission approvals are the person's, never answered here.

threadId.description: This thread, one you started or, with full access, any.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

answers.description: Question id to chosen option ids, or free text where other is allowed.

tools.name: queue_edit
tools.title: Edit queued messages
tools.description: Change an owned thread's queued messages before delivery (thread_read lists entryIds): edit its text (attachments stay), cancel it, steer it into the running turn now, or reorder named entries to the front.

threadId.description: This thread, one you started or, with full access, any.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

action.description: edit: entryId, text. cancel, steer: entryId. reorder: order.

order.description: Entry ids, in their new order.

tools.name: suit_apply
tools.title: Preview, keep or revert a Suit
tools.description: Put a Suit (ace look from ~/.ace/suits) on the person's devices. Checks run first: failures come back as problems and nothing applies. A preview or keep then returns what the devices saw as rendered (live problems) and screenshots. Read guide make-a-suit first.

mode.description: preview shows it until you keep it or your turn ends; keep stores it; revert ends your preview or undoes your last keep.

id.description: The Suit's folder name in ~/.ace/suits. Needed for preview; keep defaults to your preview.

tools.name: thread_control
tools.title: Change an owned thread
tools.description: Change a thread you own (this one, ones you started or, with full access, any): rename, configure its model, hand off to a worktree, interrupt, settle or unsettle, snooze, close a preview, or rename this project. Settle only when the person explicitly asks; finished work is not a request.

action.description: rename: title, or none to retitle from the first message. configure: model, effort. handoff: branch. interrupt: stops its turn and children. settle: a working thread settles once done, unless it fails or needs the person. unsettle: also cancels a pending settle. snooze: until. close_preview: previewId. rename_project: name.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

onlyIfProvisional.description: Only replace a title ace generated, never the person's.

model.description: Id from models, or a name ("opus 5.5") on its account.

until.description: Epoch ms, or null to unmute.

tools.name: thread_fork
tools.title: Fork a thread
tools.description: Fork a thread to try another way, keeping its conversation: text is what to try instead, optionally on another model. Forks after the latest finished turn (works mid-turn); runId picks an earlier one. The fork shares the checkout; message it or merge it back with thread_merge. The person sees a card: relay it in a sentence, without ids.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

text.description: The other approach, standing on its own.

runId.description: Fork after this finished run instead.

model.description: Same provider and account: id from models, or a name ("opus 5.5").

tools.name: thread_link_pr
tools.title: Link a pull request
tools.description: Link this thread's pull request, so the person sees its state and CI here, right after you open or find it. unlink removes a link (all: every link); the PR never changes.

tools.name: thread_merge
tools.title: Merge a fork back
tools.description: Bring a finished fork's result back to its source thread: summary says what it found or did, citing its latest answer or itemIds. The source's agent sees it next turn; file changes are already in the shared checkout. Wait for the fork to finish first.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

summary.description: What the fork found or did, standing on its own.

itemIds.description: Fork items it rests on, from thread_read.

tools.name: thread_read
tools.title: Read a thread
tools.description: Read a thread: title, status, branch, linked PRs, preview servers, queued messages (entryIds for queue_edit) and a page of its latest items, oldest first. Page back with before = itemsBefore until null; items too large are listed in omitted. A truncated part with source.streamId continues as text: pass streamId from offset 0, then each nextOffset, until eof.

streamId.description: Read a truncated part's output instead.

offset.description: With streamId: 0, then each nextOffset unchanged.

itemsBefore.description: Pass as before for the previous page; null when nothing is earlier.

omitted.description: Items too large for a page: shown without raw payloads (dropped raw) or only summarized (dropped item).

text.description: With streamId: this page of the part's text, decoded.

nextOffset.description: With streamId: pass back unchanged as offset for the next page.

eof.description: With streamId: true when the text ends with this page.

queue.description: Messages waiting for the thread, oldest first.

tools.name: thread_start
tools.title: Start a top-level thread
tools.description: Open a top-level thread in the person's sidebar, in this or another local project, when the person asks for a separate thread; text is its first message and its agent answers at once. For child work whose result you need, use delegate. The person sees a card: relay it in a sentence, without ids.

requestId.description: Any stable id; a repeat with it runs once.

text.description: First message, standing on its own.

project.description: Another local project's name, path or id, from projects_find.

model.description: Id from models, or a name ("opus 5.5").

tools.name: threads_find
tools.title: Find threads
tools.description: Find threads in this project (or, with full access, another), or search inside one. Without threadId: threads matching query, or recent ones when it is empty. With threadId: matching items in its transcript. Page with cursor.

project.description: Another project's name, path or id, from projects_find.

tools.name: tools_call
tools.title: Call an ace tool
tools.description: Run any ace tool by name, with the arguments its schema takes (from tools_find or guide). Returns that tool's result.

name.description: The tool's name, as tools_find returns it.

arguments.description: The tool's own arguments, matching its input schema.

tools.name: tools_find
tools.title: Find ace tools
tools.description: Find ace tools this session can call for a task: each match's name, purpose, effect and input schema.

query.description: In plain words, e.g. "click a button in Safari".

tools.name: transfer
tools.title: Move work to another machine
tools.description: Carry a project (default: this thread's) or this thread to another paired machine, same branch and uncommitted changes included. Returns transferId at once; the result arrives as a new turn, so end yours. Never poll.

project.description: A project here, by id or name.

thread.description: Continue this thread there as a new thread with its history.

includeIgnored.description: Send ignored files like .env. Default: the setting.

tools.name: wait
tools.title: Wait for threads
tools.description: Wait for children or other threads to settle. needs_you: one waits on the person; tell them, it is unfinished. limited: one is held at a usage limit; cancel and redelegate it, or tell the person. timeout or interrupted: they keep working; wait again, never poll.

threadIds.description: From delegate, or any thread you can read.
